entries.headline: VEGAS11 Gray Eagle sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported VEGAS11, identified in the post as an Army General Atomics NQ-1C Gray Eagle with hex code AE5C14. The sighting was credited to timharkness9152.

entries.headline: U.S. command, bomber and radar aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple high-level U.S. military aircraft airborne over the continental United States, including a nuclear-command aircraft, surveillance aircraft, bomber and airborne-radar aircraft.

entries.headline: B-52H over Louisiana sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a U.S. Air Force Boeing B-52H Stratofortress, hex code AE58B1, over Louisiana. The sighting was credited to timharkness9152.

entries.headline: Kyiv Post Su-30 crash report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Kyiv Post report that a Russian Su-30 crashed near NATO borders and its pilots ejected. The item was credited to timharkness9152.

entries.headline: Elevated Black Sea and NATO air activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported Black Sea air activity at nearly three times normal, with three U.S. Air Force transport aircraft and two NATO radar aircraft airborne across Europe.

entries.headline: Four-country defence accord report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Reuters report that Turkey, Qatar, Pakistan and Indonesia signed a defence-cooperation accord, according to Ankara, and said two outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.headline: U.S. transport and NATO radar aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. military transport aircraft airborne across Europe and the Middle East, together with a NATO early-warning radar aircraft over the Baltic.

entries.headline: Iraq–Iran border-crossing closure report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Reuters report that Iraq closed the Sheeb border crossing with Iran for a security check, citing sources, and said two outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.headline: IDF regional statement highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted an IDF statement referring to soldiers and commanders across areas from Mount Hermon to Eilat and from Lebanon and Syria to the Gaza Strip, and said two outlets had confirmed it.

entries.headline: USAF transport-aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne across several regions, including one over the North Sea, and said no coded radio broadcasts were detected during that hour.

entries.headline: Kyiv UAV impact report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Suspilne report that a UAV fell onto parked cars in Kyiv’s Desnianskyi district, saying two outlets had subsequently confirmed the report.

entries.headline: Elevated military aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple U.S. Air Force transport aircraft and a nuclear command-and-control aircraft observed during the preceding hours, describing activity over the United Kingdom and North America as elevated.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: KLAS show-week ramp tour shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a continuous tour of the KLAS ramp, noting that show-week ground activity becomes difficult after aircraft land.

entries.headline: Las Vegas Strip helicopter replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a 120-times-speed replay of Tuesday evening helicopter tours operating from Harry Reid International Airport, along the Las Vegas Strip and back.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE day-one peak replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a 30-times-speed replay of NBAA-BACE day-one peak traffic covering KLAS, KHND, KVGT and KBVU, followed by a whole-valley view.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE Tuesday traffic comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported Las Vegas valley traffic down 9% and business-jet traffic down 19% on Tuesday, October 20, compared with Monday, based on SkyGlass MCP data.

entries.headline: Las Vegas valley traffic peak replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a 30-times-speed replay of the previous day’s peak traffic across four Las Vegas-area airfields.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE day-one traffic view shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass presented a day-one NBAA-BACE live view covering four Las Vegas-area airfields, with valley-wide views and closer views of KLAS and KHND.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE traffic after-action report shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported that Las Vegas valley traffic on 19 October was down 4% while business-jet activity held steady. The post credited the data to the SkyGlass MCP.

entries.headline: NetJets Citation Latitude arrival at KHND shown
entries.summary: SkyGlass showed NetJets Citation Latitude N910QS arriving from Denver Centennial and parking on the ramp at KHND, with ramp movements marked across the sequence.

entries.headline: BACE ramp boards launched for four Las Vegas fields
entries.summary: SkyGlass announced live ramp boards for KLAS, KHND, KVGT and KBVU during BACE show week.

entries.headline: N200SG field view and airframe brief shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a field view and an Airframe Intelligence Brief for Falcon 50 N200SG.

entries.headline: Falcon 50 overrun and Las Vegas runway closures reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported that Falcon 50 N200SG rejected takeoff on runway 01L at Harry Reid International Airport, overran and struck the perimeter fence, with no injuries. It said runways 01L and 01R later reopened after inspection.

entries.headline: B737 airborne alert at Virginia Beach
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a B737 aircraft at Virginia Beach, Virginia, United States. The callsign was shown as CNV4989.
